name: Oleksandr Avramchuk
intro: I am a historian of the Cold War and transatlantic relations. My research examines political, intellectual, and cultural cooperation between the United States and East-Central Europe, with particular attention to Poland, Ukraine and Russia. I am especially interested in the long-term consequences of Cold War-era ideas, institutions, and networks for contemporary transatlantic relations and the politics of the region.
tagline: Historian of the Cold War, cultural diplomacy, and East-Central Europe.
